intro.text:
Layout rules (spec 02)

• Sticky header: brand · nav · theme · language
• < 768px: header keeps brand + toggles; nav moves to a fixed bottom bar
• Nav: Instruments · Portfolio (no search screen)
• Search box on Instruments: empty → full list, typed → /search results in the same table/cards, synced to ?q=
• Content max-width 1200px
• Desktop: semantic table · mobile: cards with full-width action
• Order ticket: centered modal ≥ 768px, bottom sheet below
• ES is the default language, so copy and number formats are shown in ES
